name: Key Vault
description: Azure Key Vault naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework — Microsoft's guidance collection for structuring and naming cloud resources). Vault names are publicly resolvable and globally unique: 3–24 characters, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only, must start with a letter, end with a letter or number, and never contain consecutive hyphens.

fields.name: Workload
fields.tip: IDENTITY: Entra ID, App Registrations, Managed Identities · SHARED: platform secrets shared by multiple apps · APP: single application secrets · WEB: web certificates/secrets · DATA: SQL/Storage/Cosmos keys · DEVOPS: CI/CD secrets · NETWORK: VPN/ExpressRoute/Firewall certs · SECURITY: PKI, encryption keys · MONITORING: Log Analytics/Sentinel · BACKUP: recovery vault.
